usage: policy to ensure that every user who has not pushed code does not have write access
name: Write access should be revoked for users not pushing code
description: Users who have not pushed any code to a repo should not have write access.
detailedDescription: Limiting access rights, like that of writes will reduce the risk of the code being tampered with in the event of a breach.

args.label: New User Definition
